test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Consider the statements given below and choose the correct option regarding Indian folk and tribal dance styles.

 

i) Chailam is the folk dance of Mizoram.

 

ii) Hojagiri is the folk dance of Gujarat.

 

iii) Bidesia is the folk dance of Bihar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (i) and (iii) are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chailam is indeed the folk dance of Mizoram. This dance is traditionally performed during the festival of Chapchar Kut.
 
• Bidesia is a popular folk dance-drama of Bihar, known for its unique style and thematic presentations often revolving around social issues.
 
• Hojagiri, which was incorrectly attributed to Gujarat in the question, is actually a folk dance of the Reang community in Tripura.
 
• Folk and tribal dances are an integral part of India's cultural heritage, reflecting the traditions, values, and life of the local communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chailam Dance:**

 
 
• Chailam is performed during the Chapchar Kut festival, which is one of the most significant festivals in Mizoram.
 
• The dance involves both men and women forming a circle and dancing to the beat of traditional instruments like the drum and gong.
 
• It is a celebration of the end of the agricultural season and a time for the community to come together in joy and festivity.
 
 
 
• **Hojagiri Dance:**
 
 
• Hojagiri is a folk dance performed by the Reang community in Tripura.
 
• The dance is known for its unique balancing acts where the dancers balance on earthen pitchers and showcase intricate footwork and body movements.
 
• It is usually performed during the Hojagiri festival, which is a post-harvest celebration.
 
 
 
• **Bidesia Dance:**
 
 
• Bidesia is a folk theatre form that originated in the Bhojpuri-speaking region of Bihar.
 
• It was created by Bhikhari Thakur, who is often referred to as the 'Shakespeare of Bhojpuri literature'.
 
• The dance-drama typically addresses social issues such as migration, women's rights, and economic hardships.
 
• Performances are characterized by lively music, dance, and poignant storytelling that resonates with the rural audience.
